parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO troubleshooting_reports (
  id,
  timestamp,
  specialist_type,
  issues,
  diagnosis,
  action_plan,
  severity,
  status,
  created_at
) VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  '{{ $json.timestamp }}',
  '{{ $json.specialist }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.issues) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.diagnosis) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.actionPlan) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.severity }}',
  'pending_approval',
  NOW()
) RETURNING id, timestamp, status;

nodes.name: Salvar Relatório
nodes.notes: Salva o relatório no banco de dados. A tabela troubleshooting_reports deve existir.
